During a hearing in Plymouth, Massachusetts, Judge William Sullivan set the date for a ‌second trial in a case in which the defence has argued that Clancy was in the throes of postpartum psychosis when she killed the children. The naming of Pattinson comes during the longest hiatus in 007 history and ends years of rampant speculation about who would inherit the role from Daniel Craig. item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse
item.description: A Thai court denied an attempt on Monday by former leader Thaksin Shinawatra to pause the seizure of his assets over a disputed tax bill of more than US$500 million. The Supreme Court ordered the ex-prime minister – one of Thailand’s richest people – last November to pay back taxes over the 2006 sale of shares in his telecoms firm. item.dc:creator: Maria Siow
item.description: Asean’s “calibrated engagement” with Myanmar risks backfiring, analysts warn, as the bloc moves towards rehabilitating the military-backed civilian government without meaningful peace concessions.
